plover.name: Lóa · European golden plover
plover.ariaLabel: Lóa, a golden plover flying in from Iceland
facts: In Iceland her return is news: the first lóa of the year means spring has arrived.
Icelanders hear her call as “dýrðin, dýrðin”, the glory.
Many Icelandic golden plovers spend the winter in Britain and Ireland.

hummingbird.name: Quinde · Sparkling violetear
hummingbird.ariaLabel: Quinde, an Ecuadorian hummingbird hopping up from France
facts: In Ecuador hummingbirds are called quindes, a word that comes from Kichwa.
The sparkling violetear is one of the most common hummingbirds in Quito's gardens.
Ecuador is home to more than 130 hummingbird species.
